document: A Tale of Two Voters: Shifting dynamics tighten BC Election race in its final days (Angus Reid Institute, 2020-10-20)
note: Final ARI poll before the 2020-10-24 election. Online, Angus Reid Forum, n=1,201. Shares among leaning/decided voters and those who had already voted, from the tables (2020.10.19_BC-ELXN-FINAL-PRTABLES.pdf, 'Q4/Q9/Q10. [Decided voters] Voted+ Vote/Vote Intention'). n = sample sizes printed in the table. BCU = BC Liberals; AUTRES = 'Another party' (mostly BC Conservatives). Region labels verbatim; 'Lower Mainland/ Fraser Valley' is ARI's Lower Mainland outside Metro Vancouver (coded FRASER-VALLEY); 'Island/North Coast' coded VANCOUVER-ISLAND-NORTH-COAST.
